text_en: At that time Abijah son of Jeroboam fell sick.
text_cn: 那时，雅洛贝罕的儿子阿彼雅患病，

text_en: Jeroboam said to his wife, “Go, disguise yourself, so that it will not be known that you are the wife of Jeroboam, and go to Shiloh; for the prophet Ahijah is there, who said of me that I should be king over this people.
text_cn: 雅洛贝罕对自己的妻子说：“请你起来改装，叫人认不出你是雅洛贝罕的妻子，往史罗去，在那里有先知阿希雅，他曾预言过我要作这人民的君王。

text_en: Take with you ten loaves, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him; he will tell you what shall happen to the child. ”
text_cn: 你带上十块饼，一些饼干和一瓶蜜去见他，他会告诉你孩子将来究竟如何。”

text_en: Jeroboam’s wife did so; she set out and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. Now Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were dim because of his age.
text_cn: 雅洛贝罕的妻子就这样做了：起身去史罗，来到阿希雅的家。阿希雅因年老，眼睛昏花，不能看清；

text_en: But the Lord said to Ahijah, “The wife of Jeroboam is coming to inquire of you concerning her son; for he is sick. Thus and thus you shall say to her. ” When she came, she pretended to be another woman.
text_cn: 但上主却预先对阿希雅说：“雅洛贝罕的妻子，要来问你有关她儿子的事，因为她儿子病了；你要如此这般地答复她；她来时，是作另一妇人的打扮。”

text_en: But when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, he said, “Come in, wife of Jeroboam; why do you pretend to be another? For I am charged with heavy tidings for you.
text_cn: 她一进门，阿希雅听见她的脚步声，就说：“雅洛贝罕的妻子，请进来！你为什么扮作另一妇人？我正奉命要告诉你一个凶信。

text_en: Go, tell Jeroboam, ‘Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: Because I exalted you from among the people, made you leader over my people Israel,
text_cn: 你去告诉雅洛贝罕，上主以色列的天主这样说：我从人民中提拔了你，立你作我人民以色列的领袖；

text_en: and tore the kingdom away from the house of David to give it to you; yet you have not been like my servant David, who kept my commandments and followed me with all his heart, doing only that which was right in my sight,
text_cn: 我从达味家夺过王国来交给你，而你却不像我的仆人达味那样遵守我的诫命，全心随从我，只行我视为正义的事；

text_en: but you have done evil above all those who were before you and have gone and made for yourself other gods, and cast images, provoking me to anger, and have thrust me behind your back;
text_cn: 你反而作恶甚于你以前的任何人， 且去为你自己制造别的神，铸造偶像，惹我发怒，完全背弃了我。

text_en: therefore, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam. I will cut off from Jeroboam every male, both bond and free in Israel, and will consume the house of Jeroboam, just as one burns up dung until it is all gone.
text_cn: 因此，我要降灾惩罚雅洛贝罕家，消灭以色列所有属于雅洛贝罕的男人，无论是自由的或是不自由的，一概除掉；我要扫除雅洛贝罕的家，有如人清除粪土一样。

text_en: Anyone belonging to Jeroboam who dies in the city, the dogs shall eat; and anyone who dies in the open country, the birds of the air shall eat; for the Lord has spoken. ’
text_cn: 凡属雅洛贝罕的人，死在城中的，必为狗吞食，死在田野间的，必为空中的飞鸟啄食：因为上主说了。

text_en: Therefore set out, go to your house. When your feet enter the city, the child shall die.
text_cn: 现在，你快起身回家；当你的脚踏进城门时，孩子就要死去。

text_en: All Israel shall mourn for him and bury him; for he alone of Jeroboam’s family shall come to the grave, because in him there is found something pleasing to the Lord , the God of Israel, in the house of Jeroboam.
text_cn: 全以色列人要哀悼他，埋葬他；雅洛贝罕家中，只有他得进入坟墓，因为雅洛贝罕家中，只有他行了一些中悦上主，以色列的天主的善事。

text_en: Moreover the Lord will raise up for himself a king over Israel, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam today, even right now!
text_cn: 上主必为自己另选一位君王来统治以色列，那天他要消灭雅洛贝罕家。现在，我还能说什么？

text_en: “The Lord will strike Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water; he will root up Israel out of this good land that he gave to their ancestors, and scatter them beyond the Euphrates, because they have made their sacred poles, provoking the Lord to anger.
text_cn: 上主必要打击以色列，使他们摇动如同水中的芦苇；并将以色列从上主赐给他们祖先的福地上拔除，使他们分散在大河之外，因为他们制造了阿舍辣，惹上主发怒。

text_en: He will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he sinned and which he caused Israel to commit. ”
text_cn: 由于雅洛贝罕自己所犯的罪，和他使以色列所犯的罪，上主必要抛弃以色列。”

text_en: Then Jeroboam’s wife got up and went away, and she came to Tirzah. As she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.
text_cn: 雅洛贝罕的妻子遂起身走了，到了提尔匝，一进家门，孩子就死了。

text_en: All Israel buried him and mourned for him, according to the word of the Lord , which he spoke by his servant the prophet Ahijah.
text_cn: 全以色列埋葬了他，并为他举哀，正如上主藉他的仆人阿希雅先知所说的话。

text_en: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred and how he reigned, are written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Israel.
text_cn: 雅洛贝罕其余的事迹，有关他怎样战争，怎样作王，都记载在《以色列列王实录》上。

text_en: The time that Jeroboam reigned was twenty-two years; then he slept with his ancestors, and his son Nadab succeeded him.
text_cn: 雅洛贝罕在位凡二十二年，然后与列祖同眠。他的儿子纳达布继位为王。

text_en: Now Rehoboam son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city that the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonite.
text_cn: 撒罗满的儿子勒哈贝罕在犹大为王，他登极时，年四十一岁。他在耶路撒冷，即在上主从以色列各支派中选出归他名下的城中，作王十七年；他的母亲名叫纳阿玛，是阿孟人。

text_en: Judah did what was evil in the sight of the Lord ; they provoked him to jealousy with their sins that they committed, more than all that their ancestors had done.
text_cn: 犹大人行了上主视为恶的事；他们所犯的罪比他们祖先所犯的，更激怒上主，

text_en: For they also built for themselves high places, pillars, and sacred poles on every high hill and under every green tree;
text_cn: 因为他们也在各地的高岗上，在各绿树下，修筑了丘坛、柱像和阿舍辣；

text_en: there were also male temple prostitutes in the land. They committed all the abominations of the nations that the Lord drove out before the people of Israel.
text_cn: 境内还有为神卖淫的男女，完全仿效了上主从以色列前所驱逐的异族，做了种种可憎恶的事。

text_en: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, King Shishak of Egypt came up against Jerusalem;
text_cn: 勒哈贝罕作王第五年，埃及王史沙克上来进攻耶路撒冷，

text_en: he took away the treasures of the house of the Lord and the treasures of the king’s house; he took everything. He also took away all the shields of gold that Solomon had made;
text_cn: 劫去上主殿内和王宫的宝物，全部带走，连撒罗满所制的一切金盾牌也都带去。

text_en: so King Rehoboam made shields of bronze instead, and committed them to the hands of the officers of the guard, who kept the door of the king’s house.
text_cn: 勒哈贝罕只得制造铜盾牌来代替，交给防卫宫门的侍卫长保管；

text_en: As often as the king went into the house of the Lord , the guard carried them and brought them back to the guardroom.
text_cn: 每逢君王进入上主的殿时，侍卫便手持这些盾牌；事后，仍将盾牌送回侍卫室中。

text_en: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Judah?
text_cn: 勒哈贝罕其余的事迹，他的一切作为，都记载在《犹大列王实录》上。

text_en: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
text_cn: 勒哈贝罕与雅洛贝罕之间不断发生战事。

text_en: Rehoboam slept with his ancestors and was buried with his ancestors in the city of David. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonite. His son Abijam succeeded him.
text_cn: 勒哈贝罕与列祖同眠，与列祖同葬在达味城。他的母亲名叫纳阿玛，是阿孟人；他的儿子阿彼雅继位为王。
